name: zundamon-remotion
description: Zundamon explainer video using Remotion and VOICEVOX

scripts.start: npm run sync && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts DualExplainer out/zundamon_metan.mp4 --concurrency=4
scripts.still: npm run sync && remotion still src/index.ts DualExplainer out/preview.png --frame=750
scripts.video: npm run audio:dual && npm run check && node scripts/review.js && npm run render
scripts.test: node scripts/run_python.js -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_*.py
